description: def g; defoverridable g: 1; then a macro call whose expansion holds def g. The walk counts a macro's definitions when it reserves the macro's fragment, which is when it reaches the call, so at the first def g nothing more is known to come: the default's source is published, then the replacement's (two 'function source noted' events, and a FunctionSource change a re-run of the walk repeats). The result is correct. A definition written in the body after the mark is counted up front and the default is never published (fz-3sy.7). Remove the extra write if a shape that needs it appears: for example, publish an overridable function's source when the body's walk ends rather than when the definition is reached. Blocks nothing.
title: A replacement that a macro emits after the mark writes the default's source first
